# x402-levenshtein-distance

Deterministic Levenshtein edit distance + similarity ratio microservice.
Agent-native, no-human-in-loop, exact USDC micropayments via x402 on Base.

## Endpoints
- GET /catalog — free discovery
- POST /api/distance — paid

## Pricing
~0.003–0.008 USDC per call (exact scheme)

## Usage
Send POST with JSON { "a": "...", "b": "..." }
Receive 402 + PAYMENT-REQUIRED, pay, retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.
